title: CMN: a co-designed neural architecture search for efficient computing-in-memory-based mixture-of-experts
selection_reason: The publisher abstract connects large-scale LLM MoE models with edge computing-in-memory and reports large energy savings, speedup, and model-size reduction under hardware constraints. Although its evaluation uses a Visual Transformer segmentation task rather than LLM serving, this is a concrete edge MoE hardware-efficiency contribution and should remain in the broad Discovery accept set for later Research screening.
